exploratory_note: All correlations are Spearman over 8 held-out fields and are EXPLORATORY, not causal. The dark-fraction relationship is strong and significant ONLY in the published per-image preparation (rho=-0.881, p=0.004) and disappears in the raw (rho=+0.147, p=0.73) and global (rho=+0.098, p=0.82) preparations. Between-field SD is 0.14, 0.11 and 0.13 respectively, so changing the intensity preparation removed the dark-fraction artefact WITHOUT reducing the dominant between-field variation.
